haptic_design_rules.zero_decorative_haptics: Haptic feedback is strictly prohibited on continuous scroll, decorative layout reveals, or background refreshes.

semantic_event_model.purpose: Affirm tactile selection of a filter chip, navigation tab, or map annotation pin
Confirm persistent state changes (saving a bookmark, toggling offline mode)
Alert traveler to missing schedule, closed venue, or service disruption
Tactile celebration of reaching or completing an active destination milestone
Double pulse confirming rider verification mode is actively recording on-bus stop sequence
Confirmation that audit payload was packaged and stored locally for upload
